f3.default: How to get started, step by step.

f4.default: Open an account with our broker, Vantage, verify your details and connect it to MetaTrader 4 or MetaTrader 5. Most people are set up within a working day.

f11.default: An email address and phone number, a photo ID (passport, driving licence or national ID card) and a proof of address dated within the last few months, such as a utility bill or bank statement.
